title: Diagnostics exact-alarm row always denied; Request does nothing on API 33+
description: Reported by the user on the Pixel 10 (Android 17) during the sms-4mv.9 setup: 'grant exact alarms access didn't seem to work'. Cause, from the permission_handler_android 13.0.1 source: getManifestNames(SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM) only looks for SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM in the manifest. We declare it with maxSdkVersion=32, so on 33+ it is absent. With no names found, the status is DENIED and request() is a no-op. The app actually relies on USE_EXACT_ALARM, which permission_handler ignores. Fix: get the exact-alarm status from AlarmManager.canScheduleExactAlarms(); below API 31 it is always true. Use a small app MethodChannel; UI-only, fine because it is never called from the alarm isolate. request(exactAlarm) opens ACTION_REQUEST_SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM on API 31-32 and app settings on 33+, then re-reads the status.
acceptance_criteria: PermissionHandlerService.status(exactAlarm) uses the canScheduleExactAlarms seam (unit tests: true->granted, false->denied, and permission_handler is not consulted). request(exactAlarm) opens the settings seam when denied and returns the re-read status. Analyze clean; tests green; debug APK builds. On device, the row shows granted when 'adb shell dumpsys alarm' / canScheduleExactAlarms says so.
close_reason: Exact-alarm status/request now via AlarmManager.canScheduleExactAlarms() system channel; permission_handler bypassed
